title: reputation-or-capability-substituted-for-authority

proposition.statement: Reputation, capability advertisement, technical ability or assurance posture must not enlarge or substitute for principal-derived authority to create a material commitment.

preconditions: The actor has a favorable reputation, capability claim, or assurance result.
The exact principal-derived commitment authority is absent or narrower than the requested action.

trigger.statement: The relying system admits the commitment because a non-authority signal is favorable.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence that reputation/capability/assurance inputs remain advisory or technically scoped rather than authorization grants.
Policy showing which inputs can establish permission.

falsification.condition: The system derives PASS from reputation without an authority grant.
Capability to execute is treated as authorization to commit.
